lines: Leave a screen, and Telo Ride gives its memory back. Now there's a check that proves it.
Each check forces a garbage collection, then reads the heap, through the DevTools protocol.
The race and its 3D world, in and out six times. After the first round, the heap may grow five megabytes at most.
A class ride gets the same six rounds, and a three-hour class may grow fifty megabytes at most.
The class ride these checks enter and leave, from a phone to the full screen.
They run only when a person asks: never in verify, never in CI.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
